questions.q: UConn 職涯中心建議「Tell me about yourself」照 present-past-future 講。順序是？
opts: 現在在做什麼 → 怎麼走到這裡、練出哪些技能 → 未來的目標
出生地與求學經歷 → 從第一份到現在的每一份工作 → 現在的職位
未來的目標 → 現在在做什麼 → 過去的經歷
興趣 → 家庭 → 為什麼想來這家公司
questions.exp: 原文 Start by talking briefly about what you are doing now，再 transition into how you got to where you are now，最後 lead into talking about future goals；同一頁也說不要只是重述履歷。

questions.q: MIT 職涯中心建議 STAR 四段的時間分配，行動（Action）大約佔多少？
questions.exp: MIT：Situation 20%、Task 10%、Action 60%、Result 10%，原文 most of your response should focus on your Actions。

questions.q: 講團隊專案時，MIT 為什麼建議用 I 而不是 we？
opts: 用 we 會讓雇主看不清楚你自己的技能
用 we 文法上是錯的，英文面試不能這樣說
用 I 聽起來比較謙虛，比較有禮貌
面試官只想聽個人專案，不想聽團隊專案
questions.exp: MIT 原文：using “we” statements can make it difficult for an employer to have a clear understanding of what your skills are。團隊專案可以講，但要講你的貢獻。

questions.q: STAR 的 Result 想說「從那之後就沒再發生」，哪一句對？
opts: It hasn't happened since.
It didn't happen since.
It doesn't happen since.
It hasn't happened since two years.
questions.exp: since 一路算到現在，配現在完成式；since 後面接起點，一段時間要用 for。

questions.q: 牛津學習者字典裡，cache 和 schema 的念法分別是？
opts: /kæʃ/、/ˈskiːmə/
/ˈkæʃeɪ/、/ˈʃiːmə/
/kætʃ/、/ˈskiːmə/
/kæʃ/、/ˈʃiːmə/
questions.exp: cache 一個音節，跟 cash 同音；schema 的 sch 念 /sk/。

questions.q: 面試官問 What does idempotent mean?，哪個回答最好？
opts: Repeating the same request has the same effect as sending it once.
It means the API always responds quickly, even under heavy load.
It means the request never fails, so the client doesn't need to retry.
It means only one user can call the API at a time.
questions.exp: RFC 9110：多個相同請求對伺服器的預期效果跟一個相同。冪等不保證快、不保證不失敗，也不限制同時呼叫的人數。

questions.q: 回答 What is your greatest weakness?，照哈佛職涯中心的建議，哪一個方向最好？
opts: 講一個行為上的缺點，以及現在怎麼改
說自己是完美主義者，其實是優點
說自己沒有缺點
講一個個性上的缺點，例如不夠有自信
questions.exp: 哈佛：Try to focus on behaviors, not personality traits, and talk about ways in which you are working to improve upon weaknesses。

questions.q: 每個字都聽到了，但不確定面試官在問什麼。最合適的是？
opts: Could you rephrase that?
Come again?
Could you speak a little louder, please?
What?
questions.exp: 牛津：rephrase 是換句話說讓意思更清楚。Come again? 是非正式說法；講大聲一點解決的是沒聽清楚，不是聽不懂。

opts: We discussed the design and I got a lot of feedback.
We discussed about the design and I got many feedbacks.
We discussed about the design and I got a lot of feedback.
We discussed the design and I got many feedbacks.
questions.exp: 牛津：discuss about 仍被多數人與考試視為錯誤；feedback 標 [uncountable]，不加 s、不用 many。

questions.q: 「我 2021 年進公司，從那時候一直做到現在」，哪一組最自然？
opts: I joined the company in 2021. I've worked here since then.
I have joined the company in 2021. I work here since then.
I joined the company in 2021. I work here since then.
I have joined the company in 2021. I've worked here since then.
questions.exp: in 2021 是明確的過去時間，配過去式 joined；since then 一路算到現在，配現在完成式。
